caps.zh: 今年国内|{最大}的一次地震
caps.en: The biggest earthquake in China this year.
The focus was just 10 km deep.

caps.zh: {浅源}地震|地面震感通常更强
caps.en: Shallow quakes usually shake the surface harder.
Three villages within 5 km, two townships within 20 km.
57 km to Sog County, 399 km to Lhasa.
Average altitude around the epicentre: about 4,864 m.
The official reading is M7.0, not the early 6.7.
Two injured in Gangqie; cracked houses near the epicentre.

caps.zh: 国家地震灾害|{4级}应急响应
caps.en: A national Level IV earthquake response is under way.

caps.zh: 灾情还在核实|以{官方发布}为准
caps.en: Damage is still being assessed. Follow official updates.
